description_en: Modifies the information of a consumer group in a change tracking channel (new version)
description_zh: 新版修改订阅通道中消费组的相关信息
kebab_example: aliyun dts modify-consumer-channel --biz-region-id cn-hangzhou --consumer-group-id dtsor2y66j42190000 --api-version 2020-01-01 --region cn-hangzhou
name: ModifyConsumerChannel

parameters.help_en: The region ID of the DTS change tracking instance. For more information, see https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/141033.html
parameters.help_zh: DTS订阅实例所在地域的ID，请参见https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/141033.html
parameters.name: region_id

parameters.help_en:
The ID of the change tracking instance. You can call https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/209702.html to query the instance ID.
You must specify either DtsInstanceId or DtsJobId
parameters.help_zh:
订阅实例ID，可以调用https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/209702.html查询。
参数DtsInstanceId与DtsJobId，两者必须传入其一
parameters.name: dts_instance_id

parameters.help_en:
The ID of the change tracking task. You can call https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/209702.html to query the task ID.
You must specify either DtsInstanceId or DtsJobId
parameters.help_zh:
订阅任务ID，可以调用https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/209702.html查询。
参数DtsInstanceId与DtsJobId，两者必须传入其一
parameters.name: dts_job_id

parameters.help_en: The ID of the consumer group. You can call https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/264169.html to query the consumer group ID
parameters.help_zh: 消费组ID，您可以调用https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/264169.html接口查询消费组ID
parameters.name: consumer_group_id

parameters.help_en:
The new password of the consumer group account.

The password must contain characters from at least two of the following categories: uppercase letters, lowercase letters, digits, and special characters.
The password must be 8 to 32 characters in length
parameters.help_zh:
修改后的消费组账号密码。

由大写字母、小写字母、数字、特殊字符中的任意两种或两种以上组成。
密码长度为8~32个字符
parameters.name: consumer_group_password

parameters.help_en:
The new username of the consumer group account.

The username can contain one or more types of the following characters: uppercase letters, lowercase letters, digits, and underscores (_).
The username can be up to 16 characters in length
parameters.help_zh:
修改后的消费组的账号。

由大写字母、小写字母、数字、下划线中的任意一种或多种组成。
最长16个字符
parameters.name: consumer_group_user_name

parameters.help_en: The new name of the consumer group. The name can be up to 128 characters in length. Specify a descriptive name for easy identification
parameters.help_zh: 修改后的消费组名称，不超过128个字符。建议配置具有业务意义的名称，便于后续识别
parameters.name: consumer_group_name

ErrCode.description_en: The error code returned if the call failed
ErrCode.description_zh: 调用出错时返回的错误码

ErrMessage.description_en: The error message returned if the call failed
ErrMessage.description_zh: 调用错误时返回对应的错误信息
ErrMessage.example: The request processing has failed due to some unknown error.

Success.description_en: Indicates whether the request was successful
